evidence:
Scope: independently reviewed only quality row 29, without reading other row reports or reviewer verdicts. The actual frozen XLSX was opened with openpyxl: Quality Checks!A30:D30 specifies the two real gates plus an in-dimension hard zero in every scored prompt and explicitly forbids a same-origin gate. Deterministic Checks rows 28 and 33 support prompt restatement and gates-before-scored wiring. Internal Quality Checks row 30 still mentions cross-origin apps; this historical annotation is superseded by the shipped Quality Checks row and the skill delivery profile. Frozen skill references/quality-checks.md:123-125 and staged-task-contract.md:154-158 agree with that interpretation. Current qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md requires an actual successful storage operation and independent-context readback, without inheriting unrelated feature failures.

.qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task/tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23-27 carries a binary all_pass prerequisite: a blank page, generic error or noninteractive placeholder fails; the judge enters its own new distinctive marker and must observe it in BOTH rendered preview and console after actual Run. The text explicitly says that editor text or a hardcoded sample is insufficient and that a Run control doing nothing fails. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task/tests/gates/render/prompt.md:14-20 excludes sign-in, same-origin and additional completeness/schema requirements. This rejects a convincing static editor/preview/console shell even if its example output and health endpoint look realistic.

.qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task/tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-29 requires the publicly documented /api/health success, a new ordinary UI save with observed write/response, and exact identity/title/filename/source retrieval through the normal library in an independent clean context, followed by reload and retrieval again. It states: "A success toast, health response, static seed file or localStorage entry alone is not proof of a saved record." The fresh context may not copy cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB or service-worker state. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task/tests/gates/constraints/prompt.md:24-33 supplies browser().newContext()/newPage() and closes only that context. The gate accepts application data responses OR server-rendered documents and says "Do not require a separate JSON/list endpoint." Revisions, conflicts, title validation, restart durability and styling remain separately scored. A live runner whose Save only updates browser storage and whose server supplies static seed JSON therefore cannot satisfy the required new-record clean-context observation.

All three scored prompts explicitly recheck the continuing workspace and server-supplied library after successful real gates. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:5 says "An observed gate failure zeros this dimension"; .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task/tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:13-22 says "assign binary 0 to every criterion"; .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task/tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:24-33 says "assign raw anchor 1 to every visual criterion, which normalizes to zero." Visual:39-41 states the (raw - 1) / 4 normalization, and its judge.toml uses likert with points=5. Functional/Polish are binary. Each scored gate permits a server-rendered library, an empty current library and unknown gate identities; none requires repeating durable writes or a JSON list endpoint. A missing/fatal workspace on scored reload thus receives no presentation or functional credit, while ordinary feature failures remain local. This is consistent with current independent-credit policy.

.qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task/tests/app_context.md:8 explicitly says there is no sign-in; instruction.md:1 and environment/instructions/policy.md:3 publicly establish the same no-account shared-library product. Auth checks are correctly inapplicable, rather than omitted for an authenticated product. app_context.md:16 permits missing Auto-run to fail its own outcomes without falsely failing manual Run or storage. app_context.md:20 allows external app fonts/scripts/CDNs while distinguishing the authored-snippet boundary; task.toml:22,38 sets both networks public. The two gate prompts expressly reject same-origin restrictions, and Functional:13 accepts external/CDN assets and a second local preview hostname. No cross-origin asset or opaque sandbox alone can cause a gate failure.

Wiring was inspected and TOML parsed for every dimension. Each judge resolves its own prompt.md; the two gates are binary/all_pass, the scored dimensions weighted_mean. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task/tests/test.sh:198-200 injects shared context into all five prompts; :213-227 runs gates, invokes score.py, exits on failed gates, and only then starts scored. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task/tests/tools/score.py:35-48 requires both gate scores greater than their zero floors; a failed gate sets every scored dimension to 0.0 and final reward to 0.0, and :83 returns failure to the harness. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task/tests/scoring.toml:1-8 names both gates and all three scored dimensions. The in-dimension wording is therefore supported by actual suite control flow, not an unsupported assertion that earlier tests ran.

Conforming-alternative challenge: a public local Express/SQLite app with CDN editor assets, an opaque or second-loopback preview, differently named controls, and server-rendered library forms/documents passes these gates when new authored output and the saved record are observed. The explicit acceptance of server-rendered documents, observed representations and controls by purpose prevents JSON-route/layout/same-origin false failures. A partial app missing Auto-run but with working manual Run and shared Save still passes the prerequisite under shared context:16 and loses only the relevant ordinary outcomes. Broken-app challenge: static sample output fails the fresh marker leg; real execution plus localStorage-only saving fails the independent clean-context leg; a login wall violates the public workspace requirement. No credible false-pass or false-fail witness was identified within this row.

Raw run corroboration is partial, not a configured judge measurement. qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/golden/run-golden-20260930-070504/RESULTS.json facts/S01.usable_examples/evidence/value/authored records authored.js source containing example-authored-marker, with that exact marker in rendered body and console. facts/S21.saved_record_fidelity and facts/S21.saved_records_browser_reload contain distinct saved records and exact reload observations. facts/S23.stale_save_server_refusal/first_cycle records a newly saved identity 5 and later two-editor writes/refusal; the executed driver library_flow.cjs:49-52 explicitly creates a browser newContext without storageState, opens it and loads that new record. workspace_flow.cjs:65-70 and workflow_core.cjs:142-164 establish actual authored-run, UI-save and observed-library operations. I independently checked all actual_app_files hashes against frozen solution/app bytes and these three executed driver hashes against RESULTS.json; all matched. These observations support execution and shared-storage feasibility, but do not constitute execution of the exact Render/Constraints prompts or the three scored local gates, nor adversarial shell/localStorage fixtures. Full configured-judge timing, Oracle score and target-model evidence remain unmeasured; no such claim is made by this source-level row verdict.
